transcript: Spent the morning volunteering at the food bank, sorting donations for a few hours. It's kind of repetitive work but there was a really nice moment where one of the regulars recognized me from last time and we chatted while we worked. Left feeling pretty good about the whole thing.

beats.place_detail: a food bank warehouse sorting donated goods
beats.event: Volunteered at the food bank sorting donations, chatting with a regular who remembered them
beats.quote: left feeling pretty good about the whole thing
